cards.ex: That indie film really hit the big screen and became a huge success.
cards.exUz: O'sha mustaqil film katta ekranga chiqib, katta muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kino yoki filmning kinoteatrlarda namoyish etilishi, ommaga taqdim etilishi.

cards.ex: Her latest novel is a real page-turner; I couldn't put it down.
cards.exUz: Uning oxirgi romani haqiqiy qiziqarli kitob; men uni qo'yolmadim.
cards.uzDef: O'qishni to'xtatish qiyin bo'lgan, juda qiziqarli kitob.

cards.ex: That catchy tune has been stuck in my head all day.
cards.exUz: O'sha yoqimli ohang butun kun davomida yodimda qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'shiq yoki ohangning doimiy ravishda ongda takrorlanishi.

cards.ex: The new superhero movie is expected to be a box office hit.
cards.exUz: Yangi superqahramon filmi kassabop bo'lishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kino prokatida katta daromad keltirgan film.

cards.ex: The film is based on a true story about survival and courage.
cards.exUz: Film hayot va jasorat haqidagi haqiqiy voqeaga asoslangan.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatda sodir bo'lgan voqealar asosida yaratilgan kino yoki kitob.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what the author is really saying.
cards.exUz: Muallifning aslida nima deyayotganini tushunish uchun satrlar orasidan o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: So'zlar orqali aytilmagan ma'nolarni tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The movie had a major plot twist that no one saw coming.
cards.exUz: Filmda hech kim kutmagan asosiy syujet burilishi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Hikoyaning kutilmagan va hayratlanarli o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: It's time to turn the page and start a new chapter in my life.
cards.exUz: Hayotimda yangi sahifa ochish va yangi bobni boshlash vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotda yangi bosqichga o'tish, o'tmishni unutish.

cards.ex: The song has a catchy tune that makes you want to dance.
cards.exUz: Qo'shiqning raqsga tushgingiz keladigan yodda qolarli ohangi bor.
cards.uzDef: Oson esda qoladigan va yoqimli musiqa ohangi.

cards.ex: The orchestra received a standing ovation after their incredible performance.
cards.exUz: Orkestr ajoyib chiqishidan so'ng tik turib olqishlandi.
cards.uzDef: Ijroning yuqori bahosi sifatida tik turib, qarsak chalish.

cards.ex: I've had that album on repeat all week; it's so good!
cards.exUz: Men bu albumni butun hafta davomida doimiy takrorda tingladim; u juda yaxshi!
cards.uzDef: Qo'shiqni yoki albumni doimiy ravishda qayta-qayta tinglash.

cards.ex: The movie received critical acclaim for its unique storyline and acting.
cards.exUz: Film o'zining noyob syujeti va aktyorlik mahorati uchun tanqidchilarning e'tirofiga sazovor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Asarning sifatini yuqori baholagan tanqidchilarning ijobiy fikrlari.

cards.ex: She dreams of seeing her name in lights on the silver screen.
cards.exUz: U o'z ismini kumush ekranda yorug'likda ko'rishni orzu qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kinofilmlar namoyish etiladigan ekran, kino sanoatining metaforasi.

cards.ex: This book is so captivating, I just can't put it down.
cards.exUz: Bu kitob shunchalik qiziqarli, men uni qo'yib bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kitobni juda qiziqarli bo'lgani uchun o'qishni to'xtata olmaslik.

cards.ex: The concert tickets were sold out within hours of going on sale.
cards.exUz: Konsert chiptalari sotuvga qo'yilganidan bir necha soat ichida sotuvda yo'q bo'lib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha chiptalar yoki mahsulotlar sotilganligi.

cards.ex: The author skillfully sets the scene in the opening chapter.
cards.exUz: Muallif birinchi bobda mahorat bilan sahna yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealar rivoji uchun muhit yaratish, sharoitni tasvirlash.

cards.ex: We had some soft background music playing during dinner.
cards.exUz: Kechki ovqat paytida biz yumshoq fon musiqasini qo'ydik.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy e'tiborni tortmaydigan, orqa fonda eshitiladigan musiqa.

cards.ex: I'm a big fan of classic rock music.
cards.exUz: Men klassik rok musiqasining katta muxlisiman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir yoki nimaningdir juda yaxshi ko'radigan odami.

cards.ex: The thriller had me on the edge of my seat the whole time.
cards.exUz: Triller meni butun vaqt davomida hayajonda o'tirishga majbur qildi.
cards.term: on the edge of my seat
cards.uzDef: Voqealarning rivojini sabrsizlik bilan kutish, juda hayajonlanish.

cards.ex: The band is known for their energetic live performances.
cards.exUz: Guruh o'zining jonli ijrolari bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Tomoshabinlar oldida jonli ravishda ijro etilgan musiqa yoki spektakl.

cards.ex: After such an amazing speech, he's a tough act to follow.
cards.exUz: Bunday ajoyib nutqdan so'ng, undan o'tish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi ijroni yaxshilash yoki undan o'tish qiyin.

cards.ex: I tend to tune out during long instrumental sections.
cards.exUz: Men uzoq instrumental qismlar davomida e'tiborimni yo'qotaman.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborni yo'qotish, eshitishni to'xtatish yoki ignor qilmoq.

cards.ex: I bought the band's box set, which includes all their albums.
cards.exUz: Men guruhning barcha albomlarini o'z ichiga olgan to'plamini sotib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta disklar yoki kitoblardan iborat to'plam.

cards.ex: If you have a moment, give this new song a listen.
cards.exUz: Agar vaqtingiz bo'lsa, ushbu yangi qo'shiqni tinglab ko'ring.
cards.uzDef: Qo'shiq yoki musiqani tinglash uchun vaqt ajratmoq.

cards.ex: The band is going on tour next summer to promote their new album.
cards.exUz: Guruh kelgusi yozda yangi albomini targ'ib qilish uchun gastrolga chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Turli joylarda konsertlar berish uchun safarga chiqmoq.

cards.ex: That low-budget sci-fi film became a cult classic over the years.
cards.exUz: O'sha arzon byudjetli ilmiy-fantastik film yillar davomida kult klassikasiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Katta ommaga emas, lekin katta muxlislar guruhiga ega bo'lgan film.

cards.ex: I really related to the main character in the novel.
cards.exUz: Men romandagi bosh qahramon bilan juda bog'landim.
cards.uzDef: Hikoyaning asosiy diqqat markazida bo'lgan personaji.

cards.ex: Our high school is hosting a battle of the bands next month.
cards.exUz: Bizning o'rta maktabimiz kelgusi oyda guruhlar jangini o'tkazadi.
cards.uzDef: Turli musiqiy guruhlar o'z mahoratini ko'rsatadigan musobaqa.

cards.ex: Some critics say the band sold out when they started writing pop songs.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi tanqidchilar guruh pop qo'shiqlar yozishni boshlaganida sotib tugatganini aytishadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z tamoyillaridan voz kechib, pul yoki shuhrat orttirish.

cards.ex: This small independent bookstore is a hidden gem in the neighborhood.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kichik mustaqil kitob do'koni mahalladagi yashirin marvarid.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik bilmaydigan, lekin juda qimmatli bo'lgan narsa.
